description: This source file defines the ShoppingCart entity class used in the e-commerce application. It models a shopping cart with properties like shopping cart code, line items, associated merchant store, customer ID, and audit info. It includes Hibernate annotations for ORM mapping, constructors, getters, and setters.

classes.name: ShoppingCart
classes.description: Entity class representing a shopping cart in the system, with properties for cart code, items, merchant store, customer ID, and audit information, mapped to the database using JPA annotations.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit section object associated with this shopping cart.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit section object for this shopping cart.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the shopping cart.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this shopping cart.

methods.name: isObsolete
methods.description: Returns whether the shopping cart is obsolete (all items are obsolete).

methods.name: setObsolete
methods.description: Sets the obsolete status for the shopping cart.

methods.name: getLineItems
methods.description: Retrieves the set of line items associated with this shopping cart.

methods.name: setLineItems
methods.description: Sets the line items for this shopping cart.

methods.name: getShoppingCartCode
methods.description: Retrieves the unique shopping cart code used as an identifier in the UI.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves the customer ID associated with this shopping cart.

methods.name: setCustomerId
methods.description: Sets the customer ID for this shopping cart.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with this shopping cart.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Sets the merchant store associated with this shopping cart.
